text:
ana: Hey team — ACME Models wants to onboard their open model 'VoyagerX' to Redwood's model catalog + list it on cloud marketplaces and bundle with our Edge HW partner. Need clarity on redistribution rights for quantized weights and whether we can permit hardware partner redistributions. Also they want a joint launch and an embargo window.

mike: @susan-legal do we have a playbook for permissive redistrib vs downstream commercial redistribution? my concern is dual-licensing and redistribution to HW vendors.

susan-legal: Quick high-level: open-source license type matters (e.g., Apache/MIT vs. AGPL). For commercial redistribution by HW partners we typically need an explicit redistribution grant or a separate commercial SLA. Also export control check (country of origin + training data provenance).

susan-legal: Example clause we usually ask for — please review and adapt: ```
Grant: Provider grants Redwood and Redwood's partners a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free right to distribute, sublicense, and deploy Model artifacts (including quantized/converted weights) solely as part of Redwood-hosted services or as packaged solutions with certified HW partners, subject to export controls and attribution requirements.
Restrictions: No rehosting outside of authorized cloud/edge images without Provider's written consent.
```

joel: From a runtime/packaging side — we prefer not to embed weights in marketplace images for some clouds. Recommended pattern: host canonical weights in a signed S3 bucket and provide image that pulls them at deploy time with a signed manifest. That also helps with audit logs.

tara: For HW bundles we need SKU mapping and an embargo + co-announcement plan. ACME asked for a "ship with" clause so SI partners can preload quantized weights. We need provider signoff for that.

priya: Heads-up: Some cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP) disallow vendor images that include third-party large model weights due to license/size constraints. Marketplace listing should disclose redistribution rights and provide either: (1) pointer to hosted model we serve, or (2) marketplace-approved package with provider-approved redistribution. See https://marketplace.example/doc-model-listing for checklist.

ana: (typo) meant ana: I can coordinate a joint checklist. Proposed immediate asks for ACME: 1) confirm license (text), 2) export classification (ECCN), 3) sample redistribution clause signature, 4) list of HW partners they intend to allow, 5) preferred embargo date. Can we get those by EOD Friday?

mike: Also ask ACME to confirm whether they accept our standard attribution and telemetry terms (we surface model provenance + version). If they refuse telemetry we need an outline of what they will allow for quality/regression monitoring.

susan-legal: I'll draft a short addendum template for redistribution and a checklist for export screening. I'll post a draft here by tomorrow.

priya: For marketplace flow I'll prepare a minimal packaging option: model-manifest + signed URL flow. That avoids shipping weights in the image and usually clears marketplace policy.

joel: Technical note — for HW preload we can support two delivery modes: signed tarball or S3 pull. Signed tarball requires hashing and signature verification on device; S3 pull requires credentials choreography. Both doable.

ana: (ana) timeline proposal: legal draft -> provider sign -> platform packaging test -> partner preload test -> announcement. Suggest 3-week runway if they want testing on partner devices.

tara: ok. @ACME point-of-contact please review. Also we should block a 30-min sync with ACME + HW partner + legal. Who can do availability?

ana: I'll ping them. scheduling poll now. :calendar:

deploy-bot: New meeting created: "VoyagerX onboarding sync" Tue 10am PT — invites sent to ana, tara, joel, susan-legal, mike, priya.

mike: Thanks — once susan posts the clause I'll do a quick pass. If anything looks risky for redistribution we escalate to exec review.

ana: Great progress. Next action owners: susan-legal (clause + export checklist), priya (marketplace packaging guide), joel (preload options doc), tara (coordinate HW partners). I'll update ACME and request required artifacts. :tada:
